lines.text: A landowner plants a vineyard, builds a wall, digs a winepress, builds a tower, and rents it to tenants.
At harvest time the landowner sends servants to collect his share, and the tenants beat, kill, and stone them.
Finally the landowner sends his brother, but the tenants want his inheritance, so they throw him out and kill him.
The listeners say the owner will rent to other tenants, and Jesus says God's kingdom will go to a people producing fruit.
The chief priests and Pharisees know the parables are about them, but they fear the soldiers and do not arrest Jesus.
